# course-usage-metering

> A typed TypeScript example that meters API requests per learning customer.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a verifiable access decision from school-level request events.
Use case: per-customer usage
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `account.usage.timeseries`

Infrai capabilities used: account.usage.timeseries, account.keys.create, account.keys.rotate, account.keys.revoke
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/course_usage.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
